correctness.rationale: The exact recurrence gives \(s_\star=\varepsilon/(1-\beta_2)\). Its Jacobian splits into \(\beta_2\) and a second-order block with determinant \(\beta_1\) and trace \(1+\beta_1-(1-\beta_1)\chi\). Exact Jury conditions yield the strict frontier, while the discriminant yields the plateau.
